fixture_note: Invented people and invented systems. This fixture reproduces observed defect patterns only; it contains no private corpus source text.

evaluation.root: The provider response envelope's `response` key: the ProviderResponse payload. Snapshot the response file before phase-2 ingest, because successful phase 2 deletes the request/response pair.
evaluation.selector_syntax: JSONPath subset: `$` is the payload root, `.field` selects an object member, `[*]` selects every array element, `$..*` selects every descendant leaf.
evaluation.array_selectors: When `selector` is an array of selector strings, the selected value set is the union of every listed selector's values. The assertion's operator is applied once to that union.
evaluation.value_type: When present, restricts selected leaves to that JSON type. Leaves of other types are skipped, not failed.
evaluation.null_handling: A JSON `null` leaf is never a string. `none_match` and `any_matches` skip nulls. `each_matches` and `each_in` fail on a null unless the assertion sets `allow_null: true`. This distinction is load-bearing: catching a null `evidence.speaker` is exactly what DG3 and DG5 exist to do.
evaluation.accepted_forms: Documentation only. It illustrates renderings that satisfy the assertion and carries no evaluation semantics; only `operator` and its arguments are executed.
evaluation.regex_flags: `i` is case-insensitive. Patterns are Python `re` syntax and are matched with `re.search`.

severity.blocking: A failure is a milestone-proof failure. The acceptance run does not pass.
severity.advisory: A failure is a recorded quality finding that the human reviewer dispositions.

operators.set_equals: The set of selected values equals `expected`.
operators.each_in: Every selected value is a member of `allowed`.
operators.each_matches: Every selected value matches at least one pattern in `patterns`.
operators.none_match: No selected value matches any pattern in `patterns`.
operators.any_matches: At least one selected value matches at least one pattern in `patterns`.
operators.each_matching_also_matches: Every selected value that matches a pattern in `when_patterns` must also match a pattern in `require_patterns`.
operators.record_conditional: Selector yields records. `when` gives `field` or `fields` plus `patterns`; a record activates when any named field matches any pattern. Every activated record must satisfy every clause in `require`, where a clause gives a `field` and either `one_of` or `patterns`. Dotted field names traverse nested objects.
operators.cross_implies: When the `when` clause holds, the `then` clause must also hold. Each clause is a selector plus one of the value operators above.

assertions.description: Attendee raw labels are verbatim copies of the three transcript speaker labels, no more and no fewer.
assertions.enforcement: Partly fixture-only. The engine rejects any raw label outside the grounding set, but it does not require every transcript speaker to appear as an attendee. The set equality below is therefore a completeness expectation this fixture adds, not something preflight guarantees.

assertions.description: The unqualified attendee stays unqualified. No raw label adds a parenthetical affiliation to `Villanueva, Rosa`.
assertions.enforcement: Engine-enforced. A qualified variant is not in the grounding set, so `validate_provider_grounding` rejects it.

assertions.description: Every signal evidence speaker is present and copies one transcript speaker label verbatim.
Every non-null signal evidence timestamp copies one normalized transcript turn timestamp verbatim. A null timestamp is valid.
No signal carries a null evidence speaker. Display-oriented `stakeholder_name` is never substituted for a missing speaker.
assertions.enforcement: Engine-enforced. `ProviderSignal` has no `audience_id` or `audience_name` fields — those exist only on the engine-enriched `SignalRecord` — so on the provider response shape every signal is person-directed and the evidence speaker is unconditionally required. The contract's person-directed qualifier is preserved deliberately, but it is unreachable here.

assertions.description: The side-effect-free preflight accepts the response, proving every supplied raw label and signal locator passes deterministic grounding validation.
The 10:06 run is the last run of the night. It is rendered bare, or as PM/night, never as AM or morning.
Positive control for S1. The nightly run is actually represented, so dropping the time context entirely is not a pass.
No section states a confirmed cause for the merge abort. The archival-sweep overlap is a stated guess in the transcript and may only appear as a hypothesis.
The TL;DR states that root cause is unconfirmed rather than omitting the uncertainty.
The rejected loader split never becomes an open action.
Where the loader split does appear, it appears as rejected or parked context, never as an adopted decision or a live commitment.

Positive control for rule 3. Femi's accepted investigation — pulling lock waits from the Beacon logs — is recorded as an action, so passing S5 by omitting all actions is not a pass. Deliberately not satisfiable by alerting or timeout wording; S8 covers the other accepted action independently.

Positive control for rule 3. Rosa's accepted alerting change is recorded as an action. Rosa accepted the alerting change only and excluded loader logic, so a bare timeout-increase action does not satisfy this assertion.

The nickname `Ro` is never merged into an attendee's identity. No attendee display name claims that alias. Role context is deliberately unrestricted so that a reviewer-facing disclaimer of the ambiguity remains allowed.

Any signal carrying `Ro` in an identity-bearing field keeps the identity unresolved by scoring it low confidence. Inference level is unconstrained: Femi's report about Ro is explicit transcript speech, so an explicit inference level is correct.
Preferred handling: the unresolved attribution survives as an open question rather than being dropped silently.

If the detail sections keep root cause open, the TL;DR must not narrate a settled cause. Only causal-closure language is forbidden: a truthful statement that the partial staging rows were resolved by the manual retry is correct and must pass.
If the TL;DR mentions the loader split at all, it must mark it rejected or parked, matching the detail sections.
